verdict.rationale: Raygun offers error grouping, prioritization by occurrences/users affected, filtering by version/date/host, deployment tracking to spot new errors/regressions, and a changelog-documented error frequency/trend chart — supporting core error-trend visibility. However, evidence lacks explicit cross-team/cross-project rollup dashboards or 'new issues per release' framed reporting beyond deployment tracking, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of dashboard usability at leadership scale. Missing for 10: multi-project/team aggregate dashboard views, release-over-release new-issue reporting, and independent verification of dashboard analytics quality.
